presets.title: OBR March 2026 forecast
presets.description: No changes: the baseline as published by the OBR on 3 March 2026.

presets.title: Higher gilt yields, September 2026 (illustrative)
presets.description: Interest rates 0.75 percentage points above the March assumption, roughly the rise in gilt yields reported by September 2026. Everything else unchanged. This is not an OBR forecast.

presets.title: A penny off the basic rate
presets.description: Cut the basic rate of income tax by 1p from April 2027, costed from HMRC’s ready reckoner. Everything else as the OBR forecast.

presets.title: Budget 2025 tax rises unwound
presets.description: Reverse the threshold freeze, the investment-income rises, the salary-sacrifice cap, the fuel duty freeze and the gambling duty rises from April 2027, using the Treasury’s own costings.
